_README: Nothing here names a repository. The tool scans ~/.claude/projects/, reads each
conversation's real working directory out of the transcript, and restores the
most recent one per directory. New projects are picked up automatically the
first time you work in them.
recencyDays      only restore conversations touched within this many days
maxSessions      cap on how many tabs to open (most recent first). The tool
SAYS how many it dropped -- it never truncates silently.
excludePatterns  PowerShell -like patterns matched against the resolved
working directory. Environment variables are expanded.
The home directory is always excluded, pattern or not.
Per-machine tweaks belong in ~/.claude/session-restore.local.json, which is
merged over this file and never committed. Same keys, only the ones you change.
Run restore-sessions.ps1 -DryRun to see exactly what would come back.
Run restore-sessions.ps1 -All to ignore recencyDays and maxSessions once.
